name: Solventum

logo.source: solventum.com site header SVG (solventum-logo-horz-black.svg); no Wikipedia infobox logo

description: Solventum is the former 3M Health Care business. It sells wound dressings, infection-prevention and surgical supplies to hospitals (58 percent of sales), dental and orthodontic products to dentists (16 percent), and coding and documentation software to hospitals (16 percent). Most revenue is repeat-purchase consumables with some software contracts. It sold its Purification and Filtration business in September 2025 and carries about $5 billion of debt from the spin-off. The conventional box is "Health Care Technology", but only about 16 percent of sales is software.

sub.name: Surgical and hospital devices and diagnostics

employees.note: about 10,000 in the US, 2,000 in Germany, 4,000 production employees

businessLines.name: MedSurg
businessLines.how: Sells wound dressings, negative-pressure therapy, sterilisation and infection-prevention supplies and surgical drapes to hospitals and surgery centres; repeat consumable orders.

businessLines.name: Dental Solutions
businessLines.how: Sells restorative materials, orthodontic brackets and aligners and preventive products to dentists and orthodontists, mostly through dental distributors; repeat consumable orders.

businessLines.name: Health Information Systems
businessLines.how: Sells clinical documentation, coding and revenue-integrity software and services to hospitals and health systems on recurring contracts.

businessLines.name: Purification and Filtration (divested September 2025)
businessLines.how: Sold filtration and separation products to industrial and biopharma customers; divested September 2025.

businessLines.name: All Other
businessLines.how: Small remaining businesses not in a segment; detail not read.
